notes.title: "Yakuza Rogue 2" has officially launched
notes.notes:
The initial discount will last for two weeks, and we hope everyone can show their support.
The uncensored version, which many of you are concerned about, is still in production and is expected to be available by mid to late June.
The bundle pack will go online later today (Yakuza Rogue 1&2). Players who haven't purchased Yakuza Rogue 1 (Self Defense Dojo) can buy the bundle pack with an additional 10% discount!
DLC has been uploaded and will be available online as soon as it passes Steam's review.
The achievement system is currently in production and is expected to be released within two weeks.
The collectible card system will be developed after the game achieves a certain level of sales, so we ask for your patience.
The Portuguese version will be available next week, and we would like to express our special thanks to Thiago for their translation support. We would like to express our special thanks to Scorch for helping us with English translation and edengenesis for their free proofreading assistance. Thank you very much!

notes.title: Achievement feature is now online
notes.notes: The Steam achievement feature for Self Defense Dojo is officially live! After a period of testing, the achievements that players care about have been released. Players, please strive to achieve achievements in the game!

notes.title: Uncensored version is online！
notes.notes: The uncensored version of Self Defense Dojo has been officially updated! Players can now enjoy more direct and exciting game content to the fullest!

notes.title: Self Defense Dojo Trading Cards
notes.notes: The trading card feature of Self Defense Dojo is now live. We've created various types of cards, and players can collect them during gameplay.

notes.title: ver 1.9.8
notes.notes: ver 1.9.8 Fixed the issue where memories of cinema CG2 and CG3 could not be triggered; added the functionality of running the game in the background, so now switching to other applications during gameplay will not pause the game anymore.Regarding the Steam achievement feature that players have recently been concerned about, it is currently in the testing phase, and we plan to launch it in the upcoming update. We kindly ask players to be patient and wait for it.

notes.title: ver 1.9.7
notes.notes: ver 1.9.7 Enhanced the inheritance function of multiple routes. Previously, only money and abilities could be inherited, but now WAKU coins have been added. Players can purchase items they want to enter a new route.

notes.title: Ver 1.9.6
notes.notes: Ver 1.9.6 The bug affecting dialogue display in certain regions has been fixed.

notes.title: Ver 1.95
notes.notes: The Ver1.95 update includes updated character illustrations for the DLC.
